description: Seven style-family templates parameterized for image generation. Each template has slots that get filled by the brief.

A_sticker.name: Sticker / Whisper-joke infographic
A_sticker.negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, gradient, glossy, chrome, anime screencap, stock photo
A_sticker.prompt_template: Sticker-sheet composition, 4-6 hand-cut sticker-style shapes on a solid black background (#050505). Each sticker is a brightly colored flat 2D shape (circle, rounded rectangle, badge) with a single phrase or icon. Decorative elements: hand-drawn arrows, sparkles, comic-book bursts. Headline: '{headline}' in giant sans-serif all-caps Helvetica Neue Black at 12% of frame height. Subtext in handwritten marker font. Palette: black + one accent from {accent}. White reverses for text. Mood: tweetable, memetic, sticker-pack energy.

B_brutalist.name: Sci-fi brutalist UI
B_brutalist.negative_prompt: pastel, soft, organic, photographic, gradient backgrounds, drop shadows, 3D rendered, anime
B_brutalist.prompt_template: Single black panel, 16:9. Center-aligned massive HUD-style text. Background: pure black #000000 with a 1px cyan grid line at 8% opacity. Headline: '{headline}' in 180px monospaced all-caps (JetBrains Mono Bold or Space Mono Bold) in white. Subtext in cyan #00E5FF at 24px, justified-left, with red #FF3030 inline emphasis markers like [SYSTEM] or [NEW]. Optional: a single subtle silhouette of a {icon} at 20% opacity bottom-right. Mood: hacker terminal, mission control.

C_patent.name: Vintage technical manual / patent diagram
C_patent.negative_prompt: modern, glossy, neon, gradient, photographic, 3D, screen UI
C_patent.prompt_template: Sepia paper background (#E8DCC4), fine ink-line drawing in #1A1A1A. Centered technical illustration of a {icon}. Border: thin double-rule with ornate corner ornaments (fleurons, sunbursts). Blue or red ink highlights for arrows, measurements, callouts. Top: small all-caps 'TECHNICAL MANUAL — VOLUME {volume}' in serif (Times, Caslon) with the headline '{headline}' below it in a slightly larger serif. Bottom: 2-3 numbered callouts in the same serif pointing into the diagram with thin lines. Patent-style 'FIG. 1' labels. Aged feel — slight grain, vignette, light tea-stain discoloration near corners. Mood: NASA 1962, an Edwardian engineer's notebook.

D_manga.name: Manga tape-insert / risograph
D_manga.negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3D, gradient, glossy, watercolor, soft shading
D_manga.prompt_template: Single bold flat-color background ({base_color}). Centered hand-drawn illustration in thick manga-line style (5-8px outlines, flat fills, no gradients). Screen-tone dots for shading. Headline: '{headline}' in chunky display font (Cooper Black or Hipsteria), 200px+, slightly rotated. Subtitle in same font, half-size. Speech-bubble or thought-bubble for emphasis. Risograph overprint effect — slight 2-3px registration offset where colors overlap. Mood: bangers, manga chapter titles, a T-shirt you would buy without hesitation.

E_screenshot.name: Editorial screenshot polish
E_screenshot.negative_prompt: hand-drawn, sketch, vintage, cluttered, busy, multiple screenshots
E_screenshot.prompt_template: Centered product screenshot (terminal, app, IDE) on a deep gradient background (#1A0B2E to #0F172A). Radial vignette glow behind the screenshot in electric purple #7C3AED at 30% opacity. Headline: '{headline}' in Inter Bold or SF Pro Display, white. Each screenshot bordered with a 2px white outline at 10% opacity and a 48px corner-radius. Subtle reflection drop-shadow below. Mood: App Store feature graphic, Apple keynote slide, a product launch on the front page of The Verge.

F_woodcut.name: Woodcut / analog engraving
F_woodcut.negative_prompt: modern, neon, gradient, photographic, 3D, glossy, soft, pastel
F_woodcut.prompt_template: Cream paper background (#F4ECD8) with subtle deckle edge. Single black-on-cream illustration in the style of a 19th-century engraving: cross-hatched shading, fine parallel lines, bold silhouette. Subject: a {icon}. Headline: '{headline}' in heavy serif (Bodoni, Caslon). Body text in old-style serif (Garamond) justified to a single column. Drop-cap on the first letter. Occasional #8B2A1F blood-red ink for emphasis. Mood: pirate broadside, 1880s newspaper, a manifesto from a candlelit workshop.

G_log.name: Role-log / status dashboard
G_log.prompt_template: Dark background (#0A0E1A). Centered 'terminal' panel with rounded corners and subtle glow. Inside: monospaced log lines with timestamps, agent IDs, status badges, low-saturation status colors. One line in the middle is highlighted (rendered as a 'successful' event) with a soft cyan glow. Headline: '{headline}' in JetBrains Mono Regular at 18-22px. Logger-style timestamps in #6B7280, agent IDs in #9CA3AF, log messages in #E5E7EB, success highlights in #10B981. Mood: Datadog, a Vercel deploy log, a Sentry incident summary.
